visual_thesis: Proactive preparation waits for user approval, and completed changes keep an attributable record; availability varies.
mechanism_metaphor: One continuous architectural section: source-context trays on the left contain a clear calendar leaf, mail envelope and meeting-note tile without fake writing. These feed an unfinished reply sheet in the middle. A full-height open approval boundary physically separates the prepared sheet from a revised document at right. The prepared sheet visibly stops at the boundary. A second slim attributed record strip accompanies the completed change and identifies its approver. Represent a human choice with a labeled approval joint, no person or hand. Ceramic is matte stylized illustration, no product screenshot or photorealism. Only two forward arrowheads: context into prepared draft and approval boundary into completed change. Nondirectional attribution tie between change and record. Caveat is detached.
